LESSON: WORD CLASS: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3.1: Word Class: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Word Class: Nouns
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: which occur as same in both singular and plural in sentences. 1. Why is it important to use words correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural from given sentences
2. use nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural to make sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Word Class: Nouns

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Word Class: Nouns

Teach
• Focus skill: identify nouns which occur as same in both singular and plural from given sentences.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Word Class: Nouns.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Word Class: Nouns
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which occur as same in both singular and plural in sentences. 1. Why is it important to use words correctly?
2. Which singular nouns end with letter -s?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
